author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Join us as the ESO Community Team and guests provide an early look at some features the dev team has been working on such as player experience improvements, Season One’s Nowhere Vault (formerly the Sage’s Vault), and Season Two’s Solo Dungeons.

For this show, the team will welcome the following developers:   

Associate Design Director, Mike Finnigan
Senior Systems Designer, Carrie Day
Associate Design Director, Jason Barnes
Player Experience Team Lead, Kira Ross Schlitt

For those who don’t know, Dev Updates is this year’s new series of livestreams, hosted by the ESO Community Team, and it features developers showing off some of the upcoming projects they’ve been working on over the past month. If you want to get a peek at what lies in the future for ESO, be sure to tune in!
title: ESO Dev Updates Livestream- June 2026
